title: Winged Angel in Vortex
description: A female angel with large golden wings and ornate golden armor hovers at the center of a swirling fiery vortex. She holds a glowing spear in her right hand while a bright explosion of blue and yellow light bursts from below her, surrounded by floating golden fragments against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A powerful female angel warrior with flowing hair and large golden feathered wings, wearing intricate red and gold armor, floating dynamically in the center of a swirling fiery vortex of red, orange and blue energy. She holds a glowing spear, with an explosion of light and golden fragments bursting around her, dramatic cosmic background, painted in a vibrant fantasy style with visible brush strokes.
